sourcing_limitations: The six original-work pages conflict with the By Request index: $0 display fields without valid sale prices and out-of-stock text. Keep all six as unavailable-to-checkout research leads. Ask the seller for actual prices and current stock.

curatorial_rationale: Taos landscape painter with a local gallery.
sourcing_limitations: Six larger-format available originals selected from his own page. The sources publish neither price nor artwork year. Size is not proof of price. The selection excludes a work on hold. Preserve title spelling until the artist approves corrections.

curatorial_rationale: Taos printmaker working in woodblock prints. Record original editions and reproductions separately.
sourcing_limitations: Five priced 2026 works plus Snowy Mountains (2025) were not marked sold in retrieved records. The selection excludes Three Forks Conejos and Hay Bales and Clouds because their pages show sold-out status and $0. Confirm edition size, paper/image dimensions and units.

curatorial_rationale: Taos Pueblo artist. His own shop provides originals, objects, an original print edition and clearly separable reproductions.
sourcing_limitations: Select the highest-priced available variant of each of six products. Record editions and reproductions accurately. The three painting originals behind the reproduction listings are explicitly sold. Beaded Shirt is an embossed-paper edition, #4/25. Magpie Vase is acrylic on pottery. Obtain the artist’s approval for identity, cultural context and process interpretation.

curatorial_rationale: Figurative and still-life painter with a documented Taos connection. Seller biographies and a long-term collaborator provide context.
